subject: Operations
title: The Malcolm Baldrige Award
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Malcolm Baldrige Award.

hook.text: Winning the Baldrige Award is so hard that just applying forces companies to improve dramatically.

buildup.text: The award evaluates leadership, strategy, customers, measurement, workforce, operations, and results.

discovery.text: It's not about perfection—it measures how well a company manages quality as a total system.

twist.text: Many past winners say the real value isn't the trophy—it's the self-assessment process that transforms the company.

climax.text: Baldrige winners outperform the S&P 500 by 2.5 to 1 on stock returns. Quality leadership pays.

punchline.text: The award is nice. The journey is priceless.

quiz.question: What do Baldrige winners say is the real value?
